data: All examples are hypothetical model calculations; no market data or random sampling.
units: Prices per one underlying unit; time in years with 365 days; UI volatility and rates in %, internal decimals; IV shifts in percentage points.

labs.title: Expiry P&L
labs.method: Long European far Call less short near Call, settle near leg intrinsically, reprice far leg with residual IV; subtract initial debit grown at r until near expiry.

labs.title: Time decay
labs.method: Spot and each IV fixed for all elapsed days 0..30; 30/180-day European Call legs; financed P&L at each point. This is a conditional scenario, not an expected path.

labs.title: Separate IV shifts
labs.method: Exact BSM repricing versus first-order vegaLong*dIVLong-vegaShort*dIVShort, instantaneous shock at fixed spot and remaining maturity.

labs.title: Local hedged carry
labs.method: One-day local P&L: 0.5*GammaNet*S^2*(RV^2-IV^2)/365. Continuous Delta hedge with stock and option financing, fixed common IV, no transaction costs/jumps/IV shocks. Gamma frozen locally.

sources: Existing lesson equations and independent algebraic/benchmark tests.
implementation: Original implementation. No upstream source code copied. Existing React, KaTeX, SVG chart controls and locally bundled fonts reused.
